Unofficial companion app for the **CMF Headphone Pro (B175)**.

## Downloads

| Platform | Asset | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows 10+ | `cmf-eq-windows-x64.exe` | Unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may ask you to confirm. |
| Android 7+ (ARM64) | `cmf-eq-android-arm64.apk` | Debug-signed; sideload it and allow installs from unknown sources. |

## Before applying EQ

Select **Custom** EQ in Nothing X first. The app reads the headphones' current settings when it
connects, and every write is checked with a readback.

Documentation, build instructions and limitations: see the
[README](https://github.com/vinayak-mv/CMF-Companion#readme).
